description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager component, verifying permission status queries and ensure methods for voice wake, location, and other capabilities within MacOS application context.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying behavior of PermissionManager in various scenarios related to permissions and authorization status.

methods.name: voice wake permission helpers match status
methods.description: Test that checks if the granted voice wake permissions match those ensured by the permission manager.

methods.name: status can query non interactive caps
methods.description: Test that verifies PermissionManager can accurately query the status of a list of capabilities.

methods.name: ensure non interactive does not throw
methods.description: Test that ensures PermissionManager does not throw errors when requesting capabilities non-interactively.

methods.name: location status matches authorization always
methods.description: Test that compares CLLocationManager's authorization status with PermissionManager's reported status for location.

methods.name: ensure location non interactive matches authorization always
methods.description: Test that ensures non-interactive permission request for location matches the current authorization status.
